notes.title: Shrine's Legacy Has a Release Date!
notes.content:
The Legacy Will Be Known


Hello everyone, it's finally time...to lock down a release date!



Shrine's Legacy will be launching on October 7, 2025!
[previewyoutube="1BawF3PIQwM;full"][/previewyoutube]

🔥🧊⚡💧 Cast Spells, Fight Enemies and Solve Puzzles in Action Combat
Use your weapon and magic spells to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, explore, and interact with the environment! Run on water, Make bridges out of wind, and more! Bring fear upon Aklor's hordes with your prowess!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/90fc1e9f0fbfcac4c332d057763b4dc3fa9f29dc.png"]


🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Two-player Co-op Mode
You can play in single player or in two player couch co-op modes. You can switch player 2 in or out at any time. If you have a good internet connection, you can also play online through Steam Remote Play or Parsec!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c8dc0e209b4ae066eddd5204013e78ae258854f5.png"]


🎮 Take a Journey Back to the Past


Experience a story themed by loss and how people deal with it, with heavy influence from classics of the Super Nintendo era! Fight an evil villain and his lackeys, befriend a talking postcat, spar with sentient dummies, wrestle with macho luchadors and more in this adventure!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/a711090618b887a4f342416840c24148f3449cfb.png"]


Keep Up with Our Progress 😎
Here's some of our links:

Discord: https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD

Twitter: [dynamiclink href="https://twitter.com/shrineslegacy"][/dynamiclink]



Wishlist / Follow to be notified on launch, or check out the Demo:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink]
Closing


This game has been a long, long time in the making and it's really exciting to finally be close enough to the finish line that we know the date! To everyone who's been around since the Kickstarter (or even earlier!) thank you so much for sticking with us for these years. 💖


There's just a little bit further to go...we hope you all can stick around till the end!


Until next time,



Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #38: Content Complete!
notes.content:
Nextfest and Other Events!

Firstly, letting you all know that Shrine's Legacy will be part of the indie.io (our publisher) booth at Gamescom in Germany on August 20th to 24th! We won't be personally present, but if you are there feel free to check out the booth and show your support. :)



Also, we've had an amazing last month for events in general! We participated in the June Steam Nextfest, which was active until June 16th (big thanks to everyone who checked out the demo during that time!), and were also being shown by a friend at a convention in Canada called Game Con Canada!



We most recently also participated in the Indie Quest 2025 Showcase, and The MIX Summer Showcase!



Check out our updated trailer AND our new trailer on YouTube:



Updated Trailer:

[previewyoutube="BNY60dWDWkU;full"][/previewyoutube]
New Trailer:


[previewyoutube="DY-IaYs14Js;full"][/previewyoutube]


We've had some great results from these events and our wishlists are currently looking pretty promising!


Content Complete


The game is now tested and fully playable with the entire story now integrated front to back. But there are still some optional scenes, a handful of puzzles, and more detailed collisions missing or buggy for many rooms. There are also some sprites and sound effects that have been made already but that still need to be properly implemented into the correct parts of game. And other random things like steam achievements still must be done.


Cutscene Progress


All main story cutscenes are now complete! Some of them, especially in the late game, still need a healthy layer of polishing wax, however. I've been finding it hard to choose cutscenes to show that won't be spoilery, so please forgive me. Instead, please check out the new trailers above and await the upcoming release date announcement trailer for more spicy stuff!


Map Progress


New maps were made! Now all the maps are on a first draft at minimum, though many will be returned to for some final polish. 💪



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/80bf2b35af16920e11994094d50a7349559d00ff.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4a3e4b0850235f006620cedd13284a7059c603b7.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/104547461b0f621d6de5c61bd930782038df6330.png"]


Closing


Thank you for reading another Steam Chronicle!



Until next time,



Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #37: Cutscene and Balancing Progress
notes.content:
Greetings and happy May! This will be a short update as we're busy grinding toward Content Complete for this month!

Cutscene Progress

We're on the final cutscenes. We've officially made it up to the inner part of the final dungeon, with final scenes and a handful of optional quest cutscenes remaining.

Enemy Balance and Other

Enemy balance first draft is now complete for most of the game, every enemy has now had base stats set, and only the last few dungeons and optional areas still remain to be tested.

Additionally, a bit more pixel art has been completed, and mapping has been done, although there is still just a bit more to do for both of these.

Pictured below: These guys don't mess around!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/469549a0bc44029cc01a187f8d4156fc8face7d1.gif

Pictured below: Rio and Reima patiently awaiting the game to be finished!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/44966c93c9c3921b73c49b2bfe7701eec8e4c826.gif

Closing

Hope you all have a happy May! We will keep pushing towards the finish line the best that we can. Stay tuned for more info as we accelerate into the final phase of development before SL is launched!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #36: More Mapping and Cutscene Work
notes.content:
As we enter a new month and we get closer to Beta it's time for another Shrine's Chronicle!

Mapping and Enemies Placed

Many more maps are complete, with almost all maps for the game being at a base level in appearance now. Some collision work still needs done but some progress was made for that too. The main exception to appearance being complete is the optional dungeon which still needs to have the rooms tiled. 

Additionally, all the enemy placements are now done for almost all of the maps!

Let's take a look at a couple new treasure spots:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/147c451b229b3f9ac61f763cd61930cb6facb7b1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/83fcd55f1c17084b4b0191390f3e30117e2dae31.png

Cutscene Progress

Every remaining cutscene in the game is now planned out in the code but a number still need to be scripted. However, they are closer to complete now than ever! We should be pretty close to having the cutscenes finished by the next Steam Chronicle.

Closing

Thanks for joining us for another Steam Chronicle!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #35: Cutscene Polish Part 3
notes.content:
Happy March and welcome to the 35th Steam Chronicle!

More cutscene work, maps, and pixel art have been completed!

Mapping Progress

We're getting started on finishing up the mapping for the remaining towns now (such as Omdale, seen below), along with Pyragord Mountain. Here's a couple newly mapped screenshots our main mapper Decky lined up for us to share in the update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d93a9c8a683c35c90e5a738116b8c17d2fb37559.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/6234c71516f06ffa3d92ef939dba040ec7636107.png

Pixel Art

Pixel art as mentioned before is nearing completion! There's only straggling pieces of art left that we come up with while polishing and finishing cutscenes that aren't finished now.

Here's a glow-up for our save point, including one for where quick travel is available. The artist really went above and beyond with this one, and I think it turned out amazing! :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/70604c48d37b32e168b56db3431c6942535ff179.gif

Cutscenes

Cutscenes from the 7th dungeon through the 9th dungeon are underway and should be done soon! After these are done there be only one major story dungeon left to do cutscenes for. 🙂 There is also a couple optional dungeons but the cutscenes within will be relatively simple.

Trying to avoid very spoilery stuff is challenging since we are getting deeper into the story with the most recent scenes. I will share a proper cutscene in the next update, but for now, here is our new improved effect for water rising and lowering in Veyrlorn Palace:

[previewyoutube=XntzfrzyOFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Closing

Cutscenes have been exhausting, but it's been very cool seeing them come together. There's still a lot left to do, so back to work I go. ✨

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #32: Boss AI Done + Feature Complete
notes.content:
Some big news this update: the Boss AI is completed! We are now also officially in the "Feature Complete" stage. There's still a ton of work to do on content, but it's still a huge milestone for us.

Boss AI Complete

As mentioned above, the AI for all bosses is now complete! I wanted to show off at least one so here is one of the early game bosses after the end of the demo (note that some things like sound effects are still not implemented, and boss behavior is subject to change / polish):

[previewyoutube=L2T-D2d_GMI;full][/previewyoutube]

Dungeon and Map Progress

There's been some mapping progress on the Marsh dungeon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/18401d5a3008ce28f203b1ecca62b662b58280ef.png

And additionally, many new rooms in the overworld are now mapped!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d270d3a7e90de2e68a10488fb83e60d7f200eeb7.png

Pixel Art Progress

More pixel art has also been completed! Here is a small sample preview of the many new jewel, potion, and item icons that have been made:


Cutscene Progress

Alan is done going through the cutscenes and adding portrait expressions! Additionally, a good chunk of new in-game cutscenes have been scripted.

The next couple months will be mostly dedicated towards scripting cutscenes in-game. Expect a non-spoilery cutscene preview or 2 in the next couple updates! 🙂

Closing

Completing the Boss AI is a big milestone for me personally. It's been really cool seeing them all come to life, and I can't wait to see people take them on once the game has been released! Thanks as always for reading, and...

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #31: Lotsa Random Stuff!
notes.content:
Updated GameMaker + Bugfixes

I did something I've been putting off for a while and updated our game development IDE to the newest version. This brought some new bugs with it I needed to fix which took some time. But I also took it as an opportunity to fix a lot of long-time bugs I never got around to dealing with. There's still a handful I haven't had time to get to, but it will really help out later having a big chunk of them out of the way.

Cutscene Progress

Alan is almost done going through the entire script of the game and adding character expressions to the portraits throughout! He's reached chapter 20 out of 21, so there's only 2 remaining now!

Dungeon and Map Progress

Postcat Jeff minigame is now mostly functional! Some aspects are still incomplete but this video should give you a pretty good idea of how it will work. You control Jeff the Postcat as he moves on a grid like old-school maze type games. You try to avoid the obstacles and get to the end, maybe collecting some things along the way to open up the path!

[previewyoutube=Y6GqL1I1HgU;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also gotten started planning out the mapping for another dungeon, the Hendran Marsh! There's nothing new to show yet, but there most likely will be next update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c6ee93bebf6fc699eca8ac990aa3bab966ec14d6.png

NPC Pixel Art Progress

We're almost done with NPC's! We have one more batch in the making right now, and then there will only be a few misc NPC's and extra pieces of art for them needed.

Here's a small sample of the last batch of NPCs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d3126fe486effd3d2d386f21175ed5c018bdc816.gif

Closing

That concludes yet another update! With some of this other work out of the way, next time around expect all the remaining boss AI to be completed. 💪

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #30: Boss AI Underway and Sounds finished!
notes.content:
Boss AI

The in-game AI for approximately 10 new bosses has been implemented, and all the art for each boss has been imported and is ready to be used to make the remaining boss AIs.

As a celebration of this, take a look at one of the new bosses in action: the Sand Hydra! This boss was also made through collaboration with one of our producer tier backers. 🙂

[previewyoutube=1DDlKF6G99Y;full][/previewyoutube]

It's important to note that each of the 3 heads has its own statistical and elemental properties so you'll need to experiment if you want to discover the most effective way to defeat each one.

Sound Effects Completed

All of the sound effects for the game have been completed. Some of the new sound effects were put to good use in the video above with the Sand Hydra!

Dungeon and Map Progress

With spooky season coming, it only makes sense to show off some of the major updates to a spooky dungeon called Moglore Woods. Here's a shot of the woods in action:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/7f89a6a63aacc0df2ab80f7f077b9a242799758e.png

NPC Pixel Art Progress

Another hefty chunk of new NPC's have been created! Here's a sampling of just a few of them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/0255729d8fc9c45daa4005a993bc43f03ff5ffef.gif

Closing

This has been a bit of an intense month for us working on Shrine's Legacy, trying to keep progress flowing at a steady rate! But it's been extremely exciting seeing the bosses and world come to life, and I get a little bit more antsy to finish things the further we get along.

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #29: Soundtrack complete and New NPC Art!
notes.content:
Dungeon Progress

2 more dungeons have had significant mapping progress, along with improvements to a previously mapped dungeon!

Here's a bit of new gameplay footage of the Sand Seas dungeon:

[previewyoutube=C1ad15p0xA0;full][/previewyoutube]

NPC Pixel Art Progress

We got 20 new NPCs drawn by our artists, and many more being finished up right now. Progress is going very well and there will be no shortage of interesting characters and animals to interact with!

Here's a showcase of a few new NPCs that'll be found in the world of Ardemia:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/aefbb4b2b2579d22801af8fd572b4eb3cba176e1.gif

The soundtrack for Shrine's Legacy is now roughly complete! At this time, there are 78 tracks and over 1 hour 40 minutes of original music.

Peaceful Respite - Shrine's Legacy Soundtrack on Soundcloud

The sound effects are also nearly complete! We'll show some of these in the next update, hopefully in context of the game.

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #28: Trailer, Boss Pixel Art Completed and More!
notes.content:
PixElated Festival

Happy to announce we are part of the PixElated Festival here on Steam! Please check it out and support all the awesome modern pixel art games that are out and upcoming. :)

New Trailer

First, I just wanted to share a reminder of our new trailer for the game for those who haven't seen it yet. It will probably be the last trailer we release before our release date trailer!

[previewyoutube=zLZPkUI9zmk;full][/previewyoutube]



Anyways, without further ado, here's what has been going on in the world of Shrine's Legacy since last month!

Dungeon Progress

The Crystal Cavern, a dungeon of illusions is now complete mapping-wise except for some finishing polish! A preview of one of the rooms in the dungeon is shared below.

[previewyoutube=mQCvb6JrVOs;full][/previewyoutube]

The secret optional dungeon that's being mapped has also made good progress and is also nearly finished now minus a few incomplete rooms and some polish.

Boss and NPC Pixel Art Progress

An exciting milestone has been reached with all the pixel art for bosses in the game being 100% complete!

We also got an update to the graphics for our very first Shrine's Legacy boss!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4977541578e8cf95777db73cf1c245ef35c265e6.gif

Music

More music tracks have been completed. The soundtrack is about 70% complete with 55 out ~75-78 tracks done and over an hour and eleven minutes of raw audio for the music at this time! Below is a soundcloud link to one of the tracks created this past month, extended for looping.

Shrine's Legacy OST: Separated on SoundCloud

Sound Effects

Over half the remaining sound effects that were needed since Alan started working on the sounds recently have now been created!

Closing

Little by little, we chip away at this beast of a project. But we climb this staircase one stair at a time, and the top of the flight is slowly coming into sight. 🌄

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #27: Music, Sound, NPCs, and Dungeons
notes.content:
Happy July and I hope everyone had a good weekend!

First I wanted to share some exciting news. We had the opportunity to be briefly showcased on IGN Live, where we shared some footage of a new gameplay trailer! If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, I definitely recommend checking it out, as it has some new footage that hasn't been seen before. I’m planning to add it to Steam here shortly as well!

[previewyoutube=zLZPkUI9zmk;full][/previewyoutube]
Dungeon Progress

Mapping for the final dungeon is now complete! Part of me is sad we won't be showing it off, because in my opinion it's turned out really great. But I think it's going to be an awesome surprise for you when you play the finished game. 😉

There's also been a lot of progress in the maps for Veyrlorn Palace. It is now complete minus a bit of fixes and polish, and a few story-oriented rooms we're saving for a bit later.

[previewyoutube=qgrmDB05b-Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to progress on previous dungeons, mapping for 2 more dungeons has begun. One of them is a secret optional dungeon. The other one is the Crystal Cavern, which was very briefly shown in our newest trailer recently. Here's a screenshot of how the aesthetic is coming along!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d12cf190cb103fffe1c26ce239fe02f661c2ef3f.png
Music

More music tracks have been written. You can hear one in the Veyrlorn Palace video above. 🙂

NPC Placeholders and Dialogue Implemented

Previously we had most of the NPC dialogue written. Now it is implemented in all the towns using placeholder NPCs!

Boss Art

The two bosses pixel arts that were in progress have been completed, and the final remaining boss pixel arts are now in the process of being created (and pretty deep in the progress to getting finished)! 

After we finish the boss art, we'll be getting started on new NPC art.

Sound Effects

Alan has been working on a lot of new sound effects to add to the game! We haven’t got them implemented yet, but it’ll be exciting to hear all the new sounds in action when we do.

Closing

Thanks for checking out another Steam Chronicle and I wish you all the best this July. If your climate is anything like ours, don't forget to spend time with your loved ones and enjoy the outside while the weather is still good!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #26: More New Music and Dungeon Work
notes.content:
It's June, and we have a new update for you all.

Dungeon Progress

We've made some good progress with puzzles and mapping for the dungeons. Parum Tunnel is essentially finished now, and the maps for two more dungeons are currently in progress. One of them is Veyrlorn Palace. The other I won't show off because it's the final dungeon and I know I personally don't like seeing a final dungeon before I play a game.

Here's a video of an updated map from Veyrlorn Palace:
[previewyoutube=p-q4e7Qe67s;full][/previewyoutube]

Music

The Shrine's Legacy soundtrack is well underway! Most of the music tracks that were in progress last update are now finished and a few more are also finished. I wanted to share one of the more recent tracks I've made.

Here’s a new track for one of the game's dungeons. It's supposed to sound "spoooooky". If you listen, let me know if I pulled it off. 😊

->Moglore Woods on SoundCloud

Boss Art

Pixel art for 4 different bosses were completed since the last update. There are 2 more in progress right now with the remaining ones being prepared soon.

Remaining ones... does that mean? Yup! There are only 4 bosses total in the base game that haven't had their art finished yet, the 2 that are in progress now, and 2 more that will be started soon.

Closing

Thanks so much for reading! ✨

We'll keep chipping away! Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #25: Music and Dungeon Work
notes.content:
Despite some things taking longer than we anticipated, it has been a very productive month since our last update. There's been progress on Dungeons, Concept Art, music, boss sprites, and more!

Concept Art Finished!

Alan's very happy to announce that he's completed all the concept art. That includes concept art for all the characters, NPCs, monsters, bosses, and environments for the game! This is a very exciting milestone. Here's the second to last NPC concept art that was created:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/eb71cad8ad270472e0e31cf4d2913e537584a015.jpg

This is Alvin, one of the vulpecs you'll meet on your journey. He lives in the primary hometown of the vulpecs, Illdar.

More Music Tracks Finished!

Wooh! Making music again. 😊 5 new music tracks have been finished with 5 more close or on the way this week! It's been somewhat refreshing but it's definitely tough after working on other stuff for so long.

I can definitely feel the rust shaking off while I come up with tunes. So far it seems the dungeon themes are going to be the toughest to get just right!

Boss Art

Since last month, we finished the three boss sprites that were in progress (last month we mentioned 2, but looking back it appears there were 3 👀) and we have 4 more in progress as of now.

I still don't want to show too much boss stuff yet, especially when it's not implemented into the game, but I did still want to show a taste! This is but one of the heads of the Sand Hydra, a KS Backer-assisted boss that shifts through the sands!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d6eccdff83d7e29bde610d0e73613f1248005168.gif

Enemy / Battle Challenge and Puzzles for Dungeons

We made a lot of progress on the general dungeon designs this month! There are still a few dungeons with puzzles that need some mechanics worked on or some puzzles polished, but the battle challenges, enemy placements, and puzzle locations are all roughly laid out for every dungeon besides the secret dungeon now (and even some progress was made on that one)!

Closing

That puts a wrap on this update! Thanks for reading as always and thank you all for being patient as we try to make this game the best it can be. 🙂

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #24: Dungeon Puzzles and Challenges Full Steam Ahead!
notes.content:
Happy April and welcome to Steam Chronicle #24! 🙂

Let's jump right into it.

Boss Art

Art for 1 more boss is complete, and 2 more are very close to being complete!

Enemy / Battle Challenge and Puzzles for Dungeons

Three more dungeons (one of them being final dungeon) have had their enemies, challenges, and puzzles placed. Many bugs were fixed with the more complex puzzle types. And in some cases, new ways of using elemental spells or new mechanics were added, such as minecarts in the Tunnel!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38833680/128e27e549d8d67784b7dadbdbf5113ebda897c8.gif

Pace should speed up from here since some of the more difficult mechanics and fixes were in the final dungeon, so it is very likely we'll have the remaining dungeons all prepped and ready for mapping for next month's update.

Parum Tunnel Mapping

The mapping for Parum Tunnel is almost finished. Progress went slower than expected this month due to life factors and sickness on our mapper's end, but we're confident the pace will pick up soon.

That said, things are still coming along nicely!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38833680/ea7816b883371a1836825e53136a52b65b59f621.png

Closing

And with that, we put a close on Steam Chronicle #24. Thanks for reading as always!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #23: Enemies Completed and More
notes.content:

Enemy AI
Enemy AI is now complete! This also includes the recolors we plan on using and their AI.

For example, here's the AI for couple of late game recolors of early game enemies, as seen in our debug room (a place I've been spending a lot of time lately making these AI's):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/b993f45744a3e4bcb05dc901767ef5971a334e71.png
Closing
Thanks for reading Steam Chronicle #23 and hope you have a good March! Now if you'll excuse us for a bit, we're gonna go and play some of the newly released FF7 Rebirth! 😉

Until next time,
Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #22: NPC Dialogue Roughly Completed!
notes.content:
This month we have a few fun things to talk about, including progress on the enemy AI, NPC dialogue, and more!

Enemy AI
A lot of progress was made! At this point, there are only 5 unique enemies and a handful of simpler palette swap enemies left to do the AI for. For reference, Shrine's Legacy now has a total number of 56(!) unique enemies not counting bosses so we are finally very near the finish line on this task.

To celebrate this, I did want to another enemy we haven't shown before, the Moophant:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/66d7cfd0b809ef0ba041b56c7862f53d9c5a6fd2.gif
Be wary or be trampled by its powerful stomp!

Despite being slow and big targets, they have a lot of range and damage, so be careful not to stay in one place too long while fighting them!

NPC Dialogue
Alan has also been hard at work writing dialogue for the many towns and locales in the game. In fact, we have a good starting draft to build up the towns with! I've been really used to all the towns in the game past the demo cutoff looking like ghost towns with only the essential NPCs there, so it'll be rewarding seeing them populated soon. 😊

Boss Fight Art Progress
We've made progress on the art for a few more bosses as well! We'll be keeping most of that art secret for now though to avoid spoilers.

Closing
Thanks for reading and that concludes this Steam Chronicle! I'm really looking forward to seeing the dungeons start coming to life with these beasties.

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #21: Normal Enemy AI Almost Complete!
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone and hope everyone had a good holiday season too! 🎊🎉🙌

Even More Enemies Completed!
There's still a chunk more enemies to complete the AI for, but I put a very large dent in them this month. We'll be holding back showing most of them so ya'll can be surprised when you play the game. But we did want to show off a couple! And it makes the most sense to show off a couple enemies who you've seen only without AI before now. So, without further ado:

[previewyoutube=swB2zIZH-Ow;full][/previewyoutube]
They're the Pinga and the Jama Mouse! 🐭 🥚 Note that they will definitely have some adjustments and also be less tanky in the final game.

Starting on the Boss Fights
Earlier we got the art for the first part of the final boss done, but this past month we finally got to get a real start on the art for other boss fights! We currently have two new boss fights with their art in the works!

Closing
It's been exciting seeing a lot of the enemy art we've been sitting on slowly coming to life in the form of fleshed out real and functional monsters in-game. Expect to start seeing some more final looking screenshots and videos later this year as we get closer and closer to going gold! 

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #20: More Enemy Implementation
notes.content:
New Enemy Art
Art progress has been going well for enemies. There are only a few enemies left to get art for now, not including bosses! Many of which we haven't shown, so look forward to seeing them for the first time in the final game.

New Enemy AI
More enemy AI have been completed. Below you can see a couple of the new ones which serve as obstacles rather than chasing down the player.

I'm personally a big fan of the wall sliding enemy, and a few among you might recognize its concept from a certain Super Nintendo Action RPG game. We haven't seen an enemy like that used in many (any?) other JRPG games so it seemed like a good homage to make! And the other enemy happens to be another homage, one that may be a little easier to guess! 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/8d5fd3d9e75d562ce0ac7d9582941ff25a8f0af6.gif
The purple enemy gets faster every time you deal damage to it! It can become quite comical if you let it get too fast :)

A Look WAYY Back
We shared this image as part of #ThrowbackThursday on Twitter but I wanted to share it here too. It's a great example of how far we've come over the years through hard work, learning, taking feedback, and the help from our Kickstarter backers, too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/59ac08188fc871d7526df1d596d8dccdcaae7864.png

The "OLD" image is very old, from back before the Kickstarter, and even further. It was before we really knew what we were doing with the project and how to make a game of this scale. The sprites were 4 times the size (32x32 tiles instead of 16x16 tiles like we have now). This was very hard to work with and contributed to the lack of pixel art quality in the early build. I don't think I even have to mention just how much the character designs or UI has changed and improved. 😂 

[hr][/hr]
This was Steam Chronicle #20; thanks for reading as always! By the way, while I can't share a definitive release window for the game yet, we are getting closer and it's only a matter of time before we will be able to!

We'll keep doing our best, and we hope you do too! 🌟

Until next time,
Joseph

Additionally, every spell now has additional unique special effects when hitting enemies. For example, earth and wind spells now launch the enemy into the air, damaging them when they first hit, and when the enemy lands back on the ground.

New Art
We wanted to show off a brand new enemy sprite by an artist we just started working with named Johanna ( @JoVGHanna on Twitter)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/1b05da6d2723d7cbd9e0176fafe2fa72241c0e5c.gif

Enemy Implementation
This past week we finally got to implementing some new enemies! The Newtiz is making good progress! 😀 🦎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/83bb03ac57b7672f4eaf19daf9d0e35fa33f309e.gif

Closing
That's it for Steam Chronicle #18! Thanks as always, and…

Until next time, 😉

Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #13: Final Major Demo Update Incoming
notes.content:
Hello there, and welcome to Steam Chronicle #13! There’s a good amount to go over this time around, so let’s dive into it!

Final Demo Update and Progress
Our goal is to prepare our final major demo update by early June, so that we can have it for the Steam Nextfest coming up. Aside from some new enemies and spell animations, the demo update has still largely been our focus this past month. We can't wait to share the final result of these updates and hopefully you will find them to be worth the wait. 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c0bc354e17bbbe3a81e0fa9e8a670909624fe3e3.png

If you’d like to see more, we also just updated the Steam screenshots for the game! So be sure to check those out and drop a wishlist if you like what you see and haven’t done so yet. 🙂

New Enemies
Also, enemy sprite commissions are now fully underway! This is exciting because we’ve focused on static level and overworld art for so long that it’s simply a breath of fresh air to design enemies. There is still the matter of programming their AI into the game, but this is still an exciting time for us. Here’s a sneak peek at a couple new/updated fiends below, this time made by DumpsterCat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4007e24e45ba8435ad6157f5abdbefdc95c4bb2d.gif
The Metal Head has been reworked and animations completed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/65702bc5dec8d66034e45f28f6feb538f50af48d.gif
This ghosty may be cute but don't be fooled, he's a troublemaker!

Mysterious Figure
You may remember an unknown figure in a dark blue cloak at the start of the (soon to be outdated) demo. This character is even in the key art.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4b02827b3947387f83991b926cb3f3581520d807.png
He thinks he's a sneaky fella out there on that cliff...

We’ve largely avoided talking about this cloaked figure. I assure you that whoever this person is…they are important to the story in some way. Is this person friend or foe? You’ll have to wait a while longer to find out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c409e12d0f4ba3269cfe5e09256e0f0002b43684.gif
Art update for this cloaked figure made by FinalBossBlues

Closing
Well, here we are at the close of Steam Chronicle #13. If you made it to the end, thank you. It sincerely means a lot that you took the time to read up on our current progress. Take care of yourselves and keep your mental health in check because it is very daunting when you’re stressed and overwhelmed. Always remember there are those who love and care about you. 💓


And please look forward to our (hopefully last) demo update next month! There will be some surprises in store for players…  😉


Be seeing you soon,


Alan

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #12 More Sprite and Environment Updates
notes.content:
Hiya! This is Alan taking the helm of writing this time around. It’s been a while since I’ve had a chance to write an update, so here goes.
Steam Chronicle #12 is here! Now that we’re out of March Madness, there are milestones we’ve finally cleared and more to go over.

First, progress on updating the NPC sprites and various art assets in our demo to better match the quality of the new art for the heroes is basically finished! Below are just a couple examples of the numerous updated NPC sprites. Check ‘em out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/69b25ca3a4db6a913a7bd88f644aad40edd75a90.png
Before and after of Mala, Rio's friend since childhood

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/518476f58e914a575d0350b248cccbc60a77d138.png
The Hiroshi Bros have never looked more macho! 💪

Environment Art Assets Are Done!

We are happy to announce that almost all of the environment art assets to build each area in the game are complete, thanks to the hard work of the many artists we’ve had the honor of working with. Jamie (@MagicaI_Girl), Glen (@Glentgm), Tim (@pixelgroover), and Justin (@JustinM56576532) all worked hard and the results are fantastic! There are a few miscellaneous assets that still need done, but for the most part we are ready to build out the remainder of the world of Ardemia. Other than a few odds and ends, it’s full steam ahead working on the art needed for enemies and bosses now!

Speaking of environments, the layout isn't final but we’re happy to show off a new environment! Take a look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/e3af3879a9aff912611c180e302a8bd344048caf.png
I wonder what mysterious place this is?

Shout Outs!


It’s been a minute since we’ve shouted out other cool projects. Here's a couple that are live right now (as of posting this update) on Kickstarter.
First up is:
The Golden Eyed Ghosts
If you like top-down pixel art games, check out The Golden Eyed Ghosts on Kickstarter! It's a dark fantasy Zelda-like game with metroidvania progression. The solo dev has been hard at work on it since 2020, and is finally releasing the game this year. Any support on the Kickstarter would be very helpful to them. They share the same publisher as us, but we've had our eye on their project since before we realized that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/b2d61dbee9b7c07e9b4d87d0bb086f026214a990.gif

You can support them and help them get funded at the link below! 👇
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegoldeneyedghosts/the-golden-eyed-ghosts

SELINI
SELINI is a nonlinear exploration platformer about dark and corrupted replicants, alternated gravity, an old spaceship, a deserted fishing boat, replicas of worlds into other worlds, secret tribes and much more... Get the control of the last replicant and figure out what has happened! Perhaps most interestingly, Selini is an adventure with no traditional text! 😮 It communicates through symbols, so you can play it no matter what language you speak. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/84884a0484d95792a4144b70102c123206a9beb4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/f080bbdc653a85d058251329deb2924401e33fa1.gif

SELINI is already funded, but there is an awesome Companion stretch goal and a secret goal! Check out the campaign and support it here 👇
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cymban/selini

Closing
This concludes Steam Chronicle #12. We deeply appreciate you sticking with us. Hope you enjoy the newer art we’ve changed for the demo thus far!

Be seeing you soon,

Alan

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #7: Big Progress and MAGFest!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween and welcome to Steam Chronicle #7! 🎃

First, some quick news. Weather permitting, Shrine's Legacy will be showcased at MAGFest 2023 in January! It's in the National Harbor area in Maryland. Alan and myself will be there in person, so if you are going, it's a great opportunity to say hi and visit our booth. 😊 It'd be an honor to meet you there! 🙋‍♂️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/a0cc84a2f34949b003d3516a5d9c9cb0399b1962.png

Learn more at their website linked here: Super Magfest 

With that out of the way, let's get into what's been completed since last time!

Dungeon Design Progress
Dungeon progress has been very good this month. In fact, we've managed to get the basic floor plans for nearly every dungeon complete! Not only that, but elevations, obstacle layouts, and key/lock functionality has been placed for most of the dungeons.

We still have to make them actually look pretty and finish tiling them, but having the functionality there is a big step in the right direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/b38a202ab128d97bfa41b8529028500b5cc489ef.png
Brrr...! I hope you brought a jacket

Spoopy Woods...?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/59d9ca9a6a57d169e879cf0ea6c325ba3ce61829.png
It's still very early WIP, but already looking pretty spooky!

Closing
That's all for Steam Chronicle #7, hope you enjoyed what we had to show today! Can't wait to get even more of these dungeons completed!

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #6: We’re in Alpha!
notes.content:
Welcome to Steam Chronicle #6, and it marks a very important milestone for the game's development. We've officially reached the Alpha stage! 🎉

What does this mean, exactly? It means the entire game is playable from beginning to end in some form or another. In our case, the entire floor plan of the game and the most basic form of cutscenes are all laid out (not to mention the first two dungeons being basically finished from the demo). 

It's still a very unpolished Alpha as we're still missing things like final art for each area, designing out the details and elevations of most rooms, and enemies and bosses being made and placed. So, there's still quite a road ahead of us! But it's still an exciting milestone, nonetheless!

Dungeon Design Progress
Our main goal for last time was to get the remaining dungeons floor plans finished, and I can say we succeeded on that goal. What does floor plan mean, you ask? Think empty house, but rooms intact! 

New Art and Town Progress
We're very close to finishing commissioning all the art for the towns of the game now as well! Next up will be the remaining dungeon tiles and more of the overworld. 🎨

Still very WIP, but as a teaser, let's take a short look at how the farm town of Omdale is coming along:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/13e4de1979031435db8d01e55e91e5ef76f43c05.gif

Love those turnips! 🤭 👩‍🌾

Closing
With that we close Steam Chronicle #6 and a major milestone in the development of Shrine's Legacy. Time to begin the journey onward toward "polished alpha" and eventually "beta"!

Until next time,
Joseph

Shrine's Legacy was showcased at the Gamescom convention in Germany courtesy of our Publisher! Although we weren't able to be there in-person, Freedom got a couple of good pictures for us:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/e2dc339c270498ab561ac70f9b9ddaabf03b2a66.jpg
Folks enjoying the Shrine's Legacy demo!

New Art
We got chickens and horse... I mean tiger horses now! We're still deciding on a final name for them but Tiorse has been the code name. And... Just look at them. They're an absolute unit!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/3c84ca24dba2d6af6c4031ed0c8d8481eeeb9685.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/3a2dc5dfec42b65f32afb1d13ea736f81b37ff59.gif
And look at that strut :)

🎨 There's some more tileset art that's been made as well but we'll save that for next time when we have it prepared in a more showcase-able form.

Closing
That's it for Steam Chronicle #5. As always, thank you so much for reading. Wishing you the best in September!

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #4: Dungeon Progress and Galadine Castle
notes.content:
Hello! Hope the end of your July is going well, and welcome to the 4th monthly Steam Chronicle for Shrine’s Legacy!

Inside of Galadine Castle
Last month we showed off some screenshots of Galadine, but there was no castle interior yet. Now there is! Here is a first look at part of Galadine Castle. Note it is a heavy work-in-progress!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/2c01d116704e6ba182e1cf1ee4d840bd51f07074.png

Dungeon Design Progress
So far, four dungeons and the overworld have reached the “floor plan” complete stage, two more since last month. “Floor plan complete” means all the rooms in the dungeon exist now and are connected in a way that closely resembles how they will be connected in the final game.  ✨🎉
At this point the goal with dungeons is to get all the dungeons to the "Floor Plan complete" stage or higher by two months from now, which will be Steam Chronicle #6, and to get more art done as well! At that point, we'll be at the roughest form of the alpha stage, since technically the whole game will be playable in some form, which is exciting! And then we can start deep diving into specific areas and making them complete and fun.

Closing
Just thought I’d throw that out here, but please take care of yourself in these times, folks. 🤗 Mental and physical health are no afterthought, and you have to be your own strongest advocate for taking care of it. That's all for my public service announcement. At any rate...

Thank you so much for reading Steam Chronicle #4! See you next month!

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #3: Scenes and Galadine
notes.content:
Welcome to Steam Chronicle #3, a devlog where we’ll keep you up to date on progress for Shrine’s Legacy!

Cutscene Progress
All of the basic cutscenes for the main story are now implemented into the game, and most of the ones for side content are also implemented! What this means is that both the story and the areas are now in the game in a very crude form. There's still a lot to do to actually make each area feel complete, but it's great progress to have made regardless.

Galadine is in Development
Additionally, we've gotten art from our artists for Galadine (also known as the capital of Ardemia, complete with a castle) and I got started on building that out yesterday! It's still very much a WIP, for example you'll notice that most of the shadows are missing, and the layout and colors aren't necessarily final. There's much tweaking to be done. But at any rate, take a look at some of what we have so far:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/a275c74618616e60d00250f5a38f9c5aba60e348.png

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #2: Siltens and Element Progress
notes.content:
Welcome to Steam Chronicle #2, a devlog where we’ll keep you up to date on progress for Shrine’s Legacy!
Unfortunately, life's been pretty tough on me this past month, I lost a close family member to cancer and I've been mentally recovering from it. There's been a lot of death in my family the past several years so it's hit a little extra hard. That said, I'm slowly getting back into action. And there is still some cool stuff to show off and talk about right at this moment. So enough depressing stuff, keep reading for cool stuff!

Basic Cutscene Progress
Despite things moving a bit slowly we still got a fair amount done. Firstly, we got some more basic cutscenes into the game, now up to just before the penultimate main dungeon. However in addition to the two main remaining dungeons there's still a lot of side content to put in scenes for. I wasn't able to finish these scenes for this month's update like I wanted to, so hopefully I can make up for it next time around.

Siltens is Alive
Secondly, we got a new environment commission finished, and a couple more started! We showed off a WIP of Siltens last time around, but now that art is properly in the game! Take a look:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c163a20f852f17259b7bb6f99f6442e2868acc56.gif

We've also gotten started on the capital of Ardemia, called Galadine. There's a castle surrounded by a large town, a wall, and a moat. It can be seen in the distance in our key art. It's still a bit too early to show it off for now, but look forward to seeing more of it soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/5dbb500c36ee6906963f1c231e9aac29ec79f7c5.png
Galadine is the castle you see far out in the horizon in this key art :)

Elemental Spells Progress
Thirdly, we've figured out a good chunk of what we want to do with the remaining elemental puzzles. It's not programmed into the game yet, but the ideas we've come up with so far are pretty exciting.
And... I'd prefer to not spoil them yet until we can show them off in a visual form. I'll be programming them in once we finish setting up the basic cutscenes so I'll try to prepare some cool animated gifs once we reach that point! I will say though that so far, our idea for Wind could be my favorite of the new element/puzzle ideas.

Closing
That's it for the second official Steam Chronicle! Again, I apologize there's not more to show this month. We'll try to remedy that for next month. Thank you all for being understanding and supportive during this endeavor. 💓

notes.title: Shrine’s Legacy Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Shrine’s Legacy is now being published by Freedom Games (https://freedom.gg). We didn't make this decision lightly. As a few of you may know, Alan and I have been vocal about our goals of staying as independent as possible while developing Shrine's Legacy. And that hasn't changed; with Freedom Games, true to their name, we maintain complete creative and development freedom. Freedom will be helping us by taking care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing Shrine's Legacy. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. And in return, we can spend more time actually building an awesome game for you all to enjoy.

You may also be concerned about horror stories of publishers ruining the vision of a game or forcing arbitrary restrictions on the dev team. Know that we were very careful when considering whether to go with a publisher or not, and selected Freedom because they are committed to our vision of the game and making the game and its launch the best it can be.

With the big announcement done, it's time to get into the dev progress updates! That’s right, we’ve decided to start updating Steam with a devlog each month, which will share a bit of the progress and behind-the-scenes of working on the game as we go along.

Story Cutscene Progress
As of writing this, I've managed to build basic scenes in the game up to when you obtain the 6th gemstone. So, good progress has been made! With some diligence, the full game worth of scenes should be finished by next month's Steam Chronicle! 💪 It'll be immensely satisfying to have the full story text play out in the game, even if it is in a simple state.

Siltens
Here's a work-in-progress of a new area! It's called Siltens, and it's a town located in a large canyon. The views are spectacular and so it's rather effective at pulling in tourists. Since it's still a WIP expect some adjustments and changes for the final game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/0632c2d76a09e80391428c8df7f505e7ede33b75.png

We can’t wait for you all to get to see and play more of the game. Thank you for all of the support you've given us. If you want to keep up with our development progress a bit closer, make sure to follow us on Twitter or join our Discord. While you’re here on Steam, make sure to wishlist the game as well!

notes.title: Official Steam Demo release and Demo v1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 is now out

In addition, you can now play the demo on Steam without joining the mailing list now! Just download the demo from the official Steam page: Shrine's Legacy on Steam

Important Notes for those who have played the Mailing List Demo:

Unfortunately, owning the mailing list demo may cause issues with downloading the new demo. Because of this, we will be disabling the Steam keys for the Mailing list version of the demo shortly, but the DRM-free version from our mailing list should continue to work if you wish to keep playing the older version in the future. Once we disable the Mailing List demo keys, you should no longer have any issues downloading the new version of the demo directly from Steam via the above link.

Additionally, if you played the demo via our mailing list before this, please note that the new version of the demo uses a new folder for storing config and save files, which means by default your save data and config settings will be gone when you start up the game again.

However, It is possible to copy the contents from the old folder to the new folder and they should work. Both folders should be in appdata for most windows machines. The old folder is called "Project_Shrine" and the new folder is called "Shrines_Legacy". 

If you copy the files over you should be able to continue where you left off. The new save files will not be backwards compatible though due to changes in how Game Maker handles save files in its newest version, so keep this in mind.

Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 Patch Notes:

Major Changes:

Updated Shrine's Legacy to the newest version of GameMaker Studio 2.
It's now possible to switch characters and play co-op as soon as Reima joins the party.
Uses a new folder to save and load config and save file data from.
Somewhat major co-op changes, listed next.

Co-op Changes:

When Player 2 triggers a cutscene by walking into a trigger, they will now be in control of that conversation (before, it was always P1).
When the party changes, players will get to keep control of their respective characters they had BEFORE the party change.
It's now possible for P2 to control P1 if there's currently no second character. You can switch between the two players at any time by pressing any major button or start button on the respective player's controller or keyboard.

Bug Fixes:

Using a HP or MP increasing potion on a character that's not in the party no longer causes a potion to fly across space and time.
Footstep sounds now properly play when important characters in scenes are running.
Fixed a bug where you could potentially cause issues in a couple of different scenes in co-op mode when P1 was down at the end of a battle event.
Fixed a mistake in the intro where the sprite of the character didn't quite match up when their eyes blink.
Fixed a oversight where the game could think that a character is outside of a building when they are really inside the building.
Fixed an exploit where Reima could get free EXP every time the player saves/loads at a specific moment in the game.
Fixed a crash that could happen when loading the game with a specific jewel equipped to a specific character.

Other:

Removed links to website and other places now that this is an official release of the demo. Also adjusted post-credits text a bit.
Made an adjustment to a room in the first dungeon to make the way to progress easier to understand.
Updated the art on the Postcat Office.




Oh... also, we never actually posted patch notes for the v1.5 of the demo (and there were a lot!), so I'll include those here too:

Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.5 Patch Notes:

Major Changes:

World Map added! You now get a map at the beginning of the game and can see the layout of the world of Ardemia!
Many adjustments to combat and enemies to make both hitting and getting hit feel more impactful.
We have a new Logo for the game now! It's implemented both on the Title Screen and in-game.
A special surprise if you find and talk to the goats in the pen at the beginning.

Adjustments:

Slight rebalancing of most enemies and bosses.
Knockback has been increased all around the board, both for players and enemies. Many enemies have had their hp has been slightly decreased to account for this.
Enemies have slightly more damage on average.
Dash attacks have slightly increased i-frames. You'll still take damage if dash attacking recklessly though.
There is now hitstun when getting hit/ hitting enemies.
When taking damage, you can't act instantly like before: there is now a short stun period where you can't do anything.
Critical hits (i.e. exploiting weaknesses) now have new cool effects to show that you're dealing extra damage.
You can now speak to npcs and examine objects from further away.
Opening a treasure with a jewel in it now gives you a description of what that jewel does.
Changed the wording and order of the options when speaking to Delane in Marize to make more sense and be clearer.
The dummy juice is now slightly more effective. ;)
If you are dashing but not holding the dash button, you'll now do a normal attack instead of a dash attack when attacking.
Adjusted credits at end to be up-to-date.
Lodestone jewel now pulls in pickups with less delay.
Lots of small cutscene adjustments.

Aesthetics:

Getting hit has much more effects now. Hitstun added, which makes it look more impactful when damage is dealt or taken. Players now flash red when hit as well.
Adjusted the minions in the opening with the cloaked figure and added a new big minion.
Player UI, boss health bars, enemy healthbars, revivebars and more have all been greatly improved visually.
There are visual effects for stepping in certain terrain now, such as leaves in the grass, and footsteps in the sand on the beach.
Wind-blown leaves now flow in the forest.
Adjusted the shadow of the Froogah enemy and the hitbox of the friendly Froogah NPC.
Adjusted Aklor's shadow positioning.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where your animation would reset every time you turned while dashing.
Fixed an input bug where letting go of a button for exactly one frame, then repressing it would still count as you not pressing the button.
If you are controlling Reima during the beginning of the mask fight, you will now automatically switch to Rio at the start of the fight.
Fixed a small camera bug at the beginning of the final scene of the demo.
The light orbs the mask boss could shoot had health and could be hit, but wouldn't be destroyed even at 0 hp. Now they are destroyed at 0 hp.
You can no longer faintly see the cloud fog over the credits screen now.
Fixed a bug where the light orbs surrounding the trap monsters could survive when finishing off the trap with an ice spell.
Fixed a bug that would show text when rapidly exitting or entering Carolyn's basement via the door after speaking with the save point outside.
Fixed a bug where Reima sometimes wouldn't move to the doorway properly for the scene when first entering Carolyn's house.
Normally when attacking the slime boss, it will create it's next set of slimes quicker for each hit you land. This wasn't working for the second phase of the battle, but has now been fixed.
Fixed three uncommon bugs related to 2 player mode and roofs appearing/disappearing at the wrong time in Marize.


If you decide to play for the first time, hope you you enjoy the demo! And if you a returning player, we hope you enjoy the updates!

We also have a public Discord where we love to hear player feedback and ideas or even just chat! Check it out if you are interested: https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD

At any rate, that's all for now,

Until next time!
